# Third-party telemetry datasets

## Spreewaldring TrackAddict log (`STC_log.csv`)

- **Source:** [thomasjungblut/trackaddict-cli](https://github.com/thomasjungblut/trackaddict-cli) example file `example/STC_log.csv`
- **Author:** Thomas Jungblut
- **License:** Apache License 2.0 (see `trackaddict-cli-LICENSE.txt`)
- **Track:** Spreewaldring Training Center, Brandenburg, Germany
- **Use in Apex:** Parsed and downsampled into `public/datasets/spreewaldring-stc.json` for the public catalog session.

RaceRender publishes a developer sample CSV at https://racerender.com/Developer/RRData.csv. It is **not** redistributed here because no redistribution license is stated on that page.
